title: Material Blend 3-Mix Trio #27 (부채꼴·물결 / 동심원·매끈 / 세로 띠·매끈 | 드래곤비늘+공작눈무늬+이레즈미 / 드래곤비늘+목재+흑요암금 / 나비날개비늘+UV네온+목재)

Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, curtain bangs long straight hair sweeping past the shoulders — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 47% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 7 o'clock, 9 o'clock and 3 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 7 o'clock ray and the 9 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the wedge between the 9 o'clock ray and the 3 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL eye-marking centres, VIVID GOLD radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 3 is the wedge between the 3 o'clock ray and the 7 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, pine and crane formations in DEEP EMERALD and STARK WHITE, extreme high-gloss oil finish. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
